title: Reproducible by Seed? Not on GPUs: Batch-Dependent Non-Determinism in Text-to-Image Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.30545v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In text to image AI models, fixing the prompt and the random seed is widely assumed to fix the image. We show that it does not on GPUs. We evaluate six text-to-image models (diffusion and autoregressive) under four numerical precisions and quantizations on three GPU types (RTX A6000, RTX 6000 Ada, and H100 NVL), across up to 100 prompts per set for all six models. For each configuration we compare, with the prompt and seed fixed, the image generated alone with the image generated inside a batch, and we also compare across GPUs. Every replay control reported here is bit-exact, so the variation is not random noise: the execution setting, mainly the batch composition and the GPU, decides the output. The effect is large and model dependent. Structural similarity between the single-image and the batched output falls to 0.580 for an autoregressive model in bf16 and to 0.551 with int8. For a second autoregressive model in bf16 it falls to 0.261

translated_title: 种子能保证可复现吗？在GPU上不行：文生图模型中依赖批次的非确定性
translated_abstract: 在文生图AI模型中，人们普遍认为固定提示词和随机种子就能固定生成的图像。我们证明在GPU上并非如此。我们在三种GPU类型（RTX A6000、RTX 6000 Ada和H100 NVL）上，在四种数值精度和量化设置下评估了六个文生图模型（扩散模型和自回归模型），每个配置对全部六个模型使用最多100条提示词进行测试。在每个配置中，我们在固定提示词和种子的条件下，比较单独生成的图像与批次内生成的图像，并进行跨GPU比较。本文报告的每一项重放对照实验都是比特级精确的，因此这种变化并非随机噪声：执行设置——主要是批次构成和GPU——决定了输出。该效应很大且依赖于模型。单个图像与批次输出之间的结构相似度对某自回归模型在bf16下降至0.580，int8下降至0.551；对另一个自回归模型在bf16下则降至0.261。
tldr: 本文通过系统性实验证明，在GPU上即使固定提示词和随机种子，文生图模型的输出仍会因批次构成和GPU型号等执行环境的不同而产生显著非确定性差异，自回归模型受影响最严重（结构相似度最低降至0.261）。
en_tdlr: Even with fixed prompts and random seeds, text-to-image models on GPUs exhibit significant non-determinism driven by batch composition and GPU type, with structural similarity dropping as low as 0.261 for autoregressive models.
